// as src/new-module.ts
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { homedir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
declare const prompt: string, version: string;
// R1185ak K2: the native installer's binary, joined from a path part.
spawn(join(homedir(), '.local/share/claude/versions', version), ['-p', prompt]);
